title: Media buyer - Google ads
description:
About vCommission Media

vCommission Media is a Leading Global Affiliate Marketing Network, delivering performance on web and mobile to worldwide advertisers through a growing network of over 100K+ affiliates. With presence in India, Singapore, UAE, UK, and USA, vCommission empowers meaningful digital growth across multiple verticals — Ecommerce, Travel, Utility, LeadGen IN, LeadGen & PPC US, and India COD Ecom.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Google Ads – E-commerce professional with 1–3 years of experience in managing and optimizing Google Ads campaigns for e-commerce businesses.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Google Search Ads, CPS campaigns, campaign optimization, keyword management, performance tracking, and conversion-focused advertising.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns for the E-commerce vertical.
* Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize Google Search Ads campaigns.
* Work extensively on CPS (Cost Per Sale) campaigns with a strong focus on conversions and revenue.
* Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis, negative keyword management, and keyword optimization.
* Monitor bids, budgets, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPS/CPA, revenue, and overall campaign performance.
* Analyse campaign data to identify opportunities for improving conversions and campaign efficiency.
* Optimize campaigns based on performance, search intent, product/category performance, and conversion data.
* Monitor tracking, landing pages, conversion flows, and campaign URLs to identify discrepancies.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective actions or escalate issues where required.

* Ensure campaigns are launched and maintained accurately within defined operational timelines.
* Stay updated on Google Ads Search features, bidding strategies, e-commerce advertising trends, and performance marketing best practices.

Requirements

* Proven experience in media buying, specifically within the e-commerce sector.
* ​Strong understanding of various digital platforms, including Google Ads, Meta, and programmatic channels.
* Expertise in budget allocation, campaign optimization, and performance analysis.
* Ability to work with cross-functional teams and adapt to a fast-paced environment.
* Business Model: Drop shipping (Ecommerce) Industry: Ecommerce

Benefits **Performance-based incentives.​**

* Hands-on exposure to Google Ads and E-commerce performance marketing.
* Opportunity to work on CPS and Search Ads campaigns.
* Exposure to the global affiliate marketing ecosystem.
* Learning and growth opportunities within performance marketing.
* Cross-functional exposure across advertiser, affiliate, operations, and technology teams.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: 10.Senior Product Manager
description:
**About** **PayPay India**
--------------------------

PayPay, a fintech company providing a service enjoyed by over 75 million users since its launch in 2018 in Japan. The company is now home to a very diverse team of members from more than 50 countries. We grew to a team of several thousand employees in Japan but are far from over. We are still in the Day 1. Every day, new members join us from all over the world to create new value and deliver it to society.

**Why India ?**
---------------

To build our Payment services, we got technical cooperation from Paytm (A large payment service company in India). And based on their customer-first technologies , we created and expanded the smartphone payment service in Japan. Therefore, we have decided to establish a development base in India, because it is a major IT country with many talented engineers, as evidenced by the fact that cutting-edge mobile payments can continue to be generated.

**OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED**
---------------------------

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realise a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined.

**AI-First Culture at PayPay**
------------------------------

At PayPay, we believe the future of software development is AI-augmented engineering. Every engineer is expected to actively leverage AI tools for code reviews, testing, documentation, debugging, and productivity improvements. AI is not optional — it is a mandatory part of our daily engineering workflow. Candidates must demonstrate both hands-on experience and the right mindset to integrate AI effectively into their workflow, while maintaining the engineering rigor, ownership, and problem-solving skills that only humans can provide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

### **Overview**

PayPay India is seeking an autonomous **Senior Product Manager** to own and drive critical credit and merchant financial products in close collaboration with PayPay group companies.

In this role, you will lead end-to-end product execution, turning business requirements into scalable platform features and seamless end-user experiences. You will work independently on day-to-day execution while collaborating closely with business partners, credit modeling experts, data teams, and engineering to deliver high-impact financial products in Japan.

### **Main Responsibilities**

* **Product Ownership & Execution:** Drive end-to-end product lifecycle for merchant credit and bank integration products from ideation to launch.
* **Cross-Entity Collaboration:** Act as the key product owner working independently with business teams, partner banks, and PayPay group companies in Japan to understand business needs and translate them into actionable product roadmaps.
* **Technical Specifications & Architecture:** Write clear, high-quality PRDs and partner closely with engineering and UI/UX teams to build scalable platform capabilities and clean user experiences.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment with Modeling Teams:** Collaborate with credit modeling, risk, and analytics teams to seamlessly incorporate scoring models, data pipelines, and decision engines into product flows.
* **Data-Driven Optimization:** Analyze product performance, user behavior, and platform metrics using SQL and analytical tools to continuously identify feature gaps and optimize customer experiences.
* **Roadmap Prioritization:** Define product challenges and opportunities, balancing speed of execution with long-term platform scalability.

### **Qualifications :**

#### **Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Minimum **5+ years** of Product Management experience (7-9 years of overall experience).
* **Technical & Analytical Mindset:** Bachelor’s degree in a technology discipline (or 2+ years in a technical role) with a solid understanding of APIs, technical system architecture, statistical concepts, and data analysis (SQL).
* **Execution Autonomy:** Strong bias for action ("Get Things Done" attitude) with a track record of driving complex initiatives independently.
* **Communication:** Demonstrated success collaborating with cross-functional and international business stakeholders.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Domain Versatility:** Prior background across fintech, e-commerce, consumer internet, or high-scale platform products
* Experience collaborating with cross-border business teams
* Experience leveraging AI/LLM tools in daily workflows (e.g., documentation, spec drafting, review, user flow mapping) while maintaining accountability for output.
* **Leverage AI/LLM-based tools in daily workflows (e.g., code development, reviews, testing, debugging, documentation), while ensuring human oversight, judgment, and accountability drive the final product.**
  

### **Remarks**

＊Please note that you cannot apply for PayPay (Japan-based jobs) or other positions in parallel or in duplicate.

### **PayPay 5 senses**

* Please refer PayPay 5 senses to learn what we value at work.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
Job Description – E-Commerce Marketplace Manager

**Company:** Birju Mahavir Pvt. Ltd. (Brijbooti)  
**Job Title:** E-Commerce Marketplace Manager  
**Department:** E-Commerce / Online Sales  
**Job Location:** Palwal, Haryana  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years in E-Commerce Marketplace Management  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented E-Commerce Marketplace Manager to manage and grow our business on Amazon and Flipkart. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end marketplace operations, sales growth, product listings, advertising campaigns, inventory management, order processing, account health and profitability.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing seller accounts on Amazon and Flipkart, with a strong understanding of marketplace policies, sales analytics and performance optimization.

Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Account Management

* Independently manage and operate Amazon and Flipkart seller accounts.
* Monitor account health, seller performance metrics, policy compliance and marketplace notifications.
* Resolve account-related issues, listing errors, policy violations and operational challenges.
* Ensure timely action on account performance alerts and marketplace requirements.

2. Product Listing & Catalogue Management

* Create, upload and optimise product listings, including titles, descriptions, bullet points, keywords, images and product specifications.
* Manage product catalogue updates, variations, pricing and category mapping.
* Improve product visibility and organic rankings through keyword research and listing optimisation.
* Coordinate with the design team for product images, infographics, A+ Content and enhanced brand content wherever applicable.

3. Sales Growth & Business Development

* Develop and implement strategies to increase sales, conversion rates and market share.
* Identify growth opportunities through product performance analysis, competitor research and market trends.
* Monitor daily, weekly and monthly sales targets.
* Plan and execute promotional campaigns, deals, discounts and seasonal sales.
* Launch new products and improve the performance of existing products.

4. Advertising & Campaign Management

* Plan, execute and optimize Amazon Ads and Flipkart advertising campaigns.
* Manage advertising budgets, keyword targeting, bids and campaign performance.
* Monitor ACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC and conversion rates.
* Optimize campaigns to improve sales while maintaining advertising efficiency and profitability.
* Prepare regular advertising performance reports and implement corrective actions.

5. Inventory & Order Management

* Monitor inventory levels and ensure product availability across marketplaces.
* Coordinate with the warehouse and dispatch teams to ensure timely order processing and shipping.
* Prevent stock-outs, excess inventory and order cancellations.
* Manage FBA, Easy Ship, Flipkart fulfilment or other applicable fulfilment models.
* Track returns, replacements, damaged products and inventory discrepancies.

6. Pricing & Profitability Management

* Monitor competitor pricing and marketplace price trends.
* Develop pricing strategies based on product cost, marketplace fees, advertising expenses and margins.
* Track SKU-wise sales, revenue, contribution margins and profitability.
* Identify loss-making products and recommend corrective measures.
* Monitor marketplace fees, settlements, reimbursements and claims.

7. Returns, Claims & Customer Issues

* Monitor customer feedback, product ratings, reviews and return reasons.
* Investigate high-return products and recommend corrective action.
* Handle seller support cases, reimbursement claims, order-related issues and payment discrepancies.
* Work towards reducing returns, cancellations and negative customer experiences.

8. Reporting & Performance Analysis

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports covering sales, orders, advertising, inventory and profitability.
* Analyse SKU-wise and marketplace-wise performance.
* Track KPIs and provide actionable recommendations to management.
* Maintain accurate records of sales, expenses, settlements and marketplace performance.

9. Team & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with warehouse, packaging, accounts, design and product teams.
* Ensure timely execution of marketplace activities and new product launches.
* Take ownership of day-to-day marketplace operations and work independently to achieve business targets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing Amazon and Flipkart seller accounts.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.
* Practical experience in product listing, catalogue optimization, sponsored ads and campaign management.
* Good understanding of marketplace fees, pricing, inventory, returns and seller performance metrics.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and reporting.
* Ability to analyse data, solve operational problems and improve sales profitability.
* Good communication, coordination and time-management skills.
* Experience in FMCG, food products, herbal products, spices or consumer goods will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly sales and revenue growth.
* Marketplace-wise and SKU-wise profitability.
* Advertising efficiency (ACOS/ROAS).
* Product listing quality and organic ranking improvement.
* Inventory availability and reduction in stock-outs.
* Account health and policy compliance.
* Reduction in returns, cancellations and operational errors.
* Achievement of monthly sales and profit targets.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a proactive professional who can independently manage Amazon and Flipkart operations, take data-driven decisions and contribute directly to the company's online sales and profitability growth.

**How to Apply:** Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with details of the marketplaces they have managed, sales volumes handled, advertising experience and key achievements.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, Account Management
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Account ManagementMastercard is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented professional to join the Financial Institutions (FI) team. This individual contributor role will be responsible for managing and growing strategic relationships with Banks and Financial Institutions while identifying new business opportunities that drive revenue growth and expand Mastercard's presence within the banking ecosystem.  
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted partner to customers, developing deep stakeholder relationships, uncovering opportunities for collaboration, and delivering innovative payment solutions that create mutual value. The role requires a combination of relationship management, business development, strategic thinking, and commercial execution.  
  
Key Responsibilities  

* Own and manage relationships with a portfolio of Banks and Financial Institutions, serving as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans to strengthen existing client relationships, increase customer engagement, and drive sustainable business growth.
* Identify opportunities within existing customer portfolios to expand Mastercard's products, services, and solutions, generating incremental revenue and increasing market share.
* Proactively scout for and secure new business opportunities with existing and prospective banking partners to achieve business development objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers, including CXOs, Business Heads, Product Heads, Payments Heads, Cards Leaders, and Digital Banking stakeholders.
* Work closely with customers to understand their strategic priorities and align Mastercard solutions to support their growth ambitions.
* Lead customer engagements and business discussions to identify opportunities across card issuance, digital payments, acceptance, commercial solutions, value-added services, and emerging payment technologies.
* Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new and existing Mastercard products and solutions.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Franchise, Customer Solutions, Consulting, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver customer-centric solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Analyse customer portfolios, market trends, competitive dynamics, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities and formulate winning strategies.
* Prepare business cases, commercial proposals, and account growth plans to support customer acquisition and portfolio expansion.
* Lead and support commercial negotiations, partnership discussions, and contract renewals to maximize customer value and business outcomes.
* Track account performance, pipeline opportunities, revenue contribution, and execution against business targets.
* Drive assigned strategic initiatives and projects from concept through implementation, ensuring successful execution and measurable business impact.

  
About You  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.
* Experience in Relationship Management, Account Management, Business Development, Sales, or Product Management within the Banking, Payments, Cards, Fintech, or broader BFSI sector.
* Demonstrated experience managing relationships with Banks and Financial Institutions.
* Proven ability to strengthen existing customer relationships and identify new opportunities that drive incremental revenue growth.
* Strong track record of delivering revenue targets, portfolio growth, and market expansion.
* Deep understanding of the payment’s ecosystem, including cards, digital payments, issuing, acquiring, and banking products.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience developing business cases, commercial proposals, and partnership strategies.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage and influence senior decision makers both internally and externally.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate insights into actionable business opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated leadership through influence and collaboration across cross-functional teams.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: UX Design Architect
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are looking for an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer who combines exceptional hands-on design expertise with solid leadership capabilities. You will lead complex design initiatives while actively contributing to research, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity interfaces, prototypes, and scalable design systems.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of creating intuitive, engaging member experiences and transforming complex, large-scale data into clear, actionable interfaces. You will help shape product direction, raise design quality, mentor designers, and collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable user and business outcomes.

This role also requires a forward-looking designer who responsibly applies AI-powered tools, automated workflows, and AI agents to accelerate design and delivery-while maintaining human judgment, data privacy, accessibility, and quality

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Hands-On Design Ownership: Lead end-to-end UX/UI design for complex digital products, from discovery and concept development through detailed interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and implementation review
* Design Leadership & Quality: Set a high standard for usability, visual craft, consistency, and accessibility. Lead design critiques, communicate actionable feedback, and ensure solutions meet user needs and business objectives
* Dashboard & Data Visualization Design: Create intuitive, data-rich dashboards and analytics experiences that help users interpret complex information, identify insights, and take action
* Member Experience: Design cohesive end-to-end journeys, personalized portals, and engagement features that build trust, simplify interactions, and support member retention
* Product Discovery & Strategy: Lead stakeholder workshops, research synthesis, journey mapping, and concept exploration to define problems, prioritize opportunities, and influence product roadmaps
* Figma & Design Systems: Lead the creation and evolution of scalable design systems, including reusable components, design tokens, responsive patterns, documentation, and developer-ready specifications
* AI-Enabled Workflows: Evaluate and apply AI tools and automation to support research synthesis, ideation, wireframing, prototyping, and documentation. Validate outputs and follow organizational privacy and security requirements
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Architects, and business stakeholders across time zones to align priorities, resolve trade-offs, and support efficient delivery
* User-Centered & Accessible Design: Champion research-informed decisions, inclusive design, and WCAG-aligned accessibility throughout the product lifecycle
* Mentorship & Team Development: Mentor designers through hands-on guidance, thoughtful feedback, and knowledge sharing to strengthen individual capabilities and overall team quality
* Design Validation & Outcomes: Use usability testing, product analytics, and user feedback to evaluate solutions and improve adoption, task success, engagement, and satisfaction
* Implementation Quality: Collaborate closely with engineering during development, conduct design QA, and ensure delivered experiences reflect the intended interaction and visual quality
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in design or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of professional UX/UI or product design experience, with a solid portfolio demonstrating hands-on execution, leadership of complex initiatives, and measurable outcomes
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled design tools and automated workflows, with the judgment to assess output quality, recognize limitations, and protect sensitive information
* Solid hands-on UX/UI expertise across information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, visual design, responsive layouts, prototyping, and usability testing
* Solid experience designing enterprise, SaaS, or other complex web-based products, balancing user needs, business priorities, and technical constraints
* Experience designing complex data dashboards, analytics platforms, and member- or subscriber-based digital experiences
* Experience working in Agile or product-led environments with multidisciplinary teams and distributed stakeholders
* Design system experience, including building, maintaining, and driving adoption of scalable components, design tokens, and reusable UI patterns
* Accessibility knowledge, including practical application of WCAG-aligned design principles and collaboration with engineering to support accessible implementation
* Expert-level Figma proficiency, including advanced prototyping, variables, reusable components, shared libraries, design system architecture, documentation, and Dev Mode handoff
* Data visualization expertise, with the ability to translate complex metrics and workflows into clear, accessible, and actionable experiences
* Demonstrated design leadership, including owning major projects, guiding design decisions, facilitating critiques, mentoring designers, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders
* Demonstrated excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain design rationale, build alignment, and navigate ambiguity

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing healthcare, pharmacy, or other regulated-industry products, with an understanding of privacy, compliance, and complex user needs
* Experience designing AI-powered, conversational, or enterprise search experiences
* Experience leading design across multiple products, workstreams, or distributed teams
* Experience establishing design governance, critique practices, and quality standards
* Experience using experimentation and product analytics to connect design improvements to measurable user and business outcomes
* Familiarity with front-end development concepts and technical constraints to support effective design-engineering collaboration

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

**What You will do:**

Key Responsibilities

1. Engineering Leadership

* Lead and manage embedded systems development and testing teams responsible for medical device products.Define engineering strategies, development processes, technical direction, and execution plans.

2. Embedded Systems Development

  **User Needs System Requirements Software Requirements Design Implementation Verification**

5. Test Automation & Engineering Excellence

* Establish a modern automated testing strategy for embedded products.Increase automated test coverage and reduce dependence on manual testing.

Establish engineering metrics to monitor product quality, test effectiveness, defect escape rates, and development efficiency.

Must Have

* Strong **embedded architecture and system-design** knowledge across software, hardware, RTOS, drivers, and interfaces.
* Proven experience leading teams through **end-to-end product development** from requirements to release and sustaining.
* Strong understanding of **verification, testing, quality, risk management, and regulated product development**.

Good to have

* Previous experience as a **Senior Staff/Staff Engineer or Embedded Architect** before moving into people management.

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

To realize our digital transformation, we need to transform our products, experiences, processes, technology and how we operate. Delivering our clients unrivalled experience of exceptional service, value and flexibility is part of our DNA. We are looking for people who are passionate about Agile ways of working and want to spread this approach within our teams and business processes.

As we advance our digital transformation initiatives, we are looking for a Platform Engineer to lead multiple strategic projects. This role combines technical expertise with strategic leadership to oversee the development, configuration, and maintenance of our digital products, ensuring alignment with market trends and business needs.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the rollout of the Smart Booking platforms/offering to BCG offices worldwide, ensuring smooth implementation and adoption.
* Maintain and manage upgrades and enhancements to the Smart Booking platforms, ensuring their capabilities are fully leveraged within our spaces.
* Evaluate Smart Office related digital products to ensure they align with market trends and business requirements.
* Facilitate stakeholder discovery for feature definition, serving as a liaison between the IT squad and stakeholders.
* Ensure epics and user stories are prioritized, updated, and available for execution.
* Write user stories and conduct refinement sessions to ensure they meet team standards and acceptance criteria.
* Support business stakeholders in eliciting business and non-functional requirements, perform gap analysis and feasibility checks, and collaborate on comprehensive test plans.
* Provide end-user support, troubleshoot issues, and answer questions.
* Utilize tools (e.g., SaaS products, SQL, Snowflake, Alteryx, Tableau) to maintain system configurations, access data, develop logic, and analyze datasets to meet stakeholder needs.
* Leverage automation tools like Python, MS Forms, Workflows in Alteryx, and PowerShell to streamline processes and enhance operational efficiency.
* Develop and implement automation scripts and workflows to improve system operations.
* Deliver AI-augmented SaaS capabilities using LLMs and Agentic AI.
* Automate workflows with Power Automate and integrate SaaS applications, APIs, and data sources.
* Work with REST APIs and MCP servers for secure AI and enterprise integrations.
* Build dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

What You'll Bring

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, ServiceNow, Jira, and Trello.
* Strong teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a global team.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to listen actively and engage with stakeholders at all levels.
* Customer service orientation with a diverse group of stakeholders.
* Ability to balance customer needs with functional goals and objectives.
* Proficiency in cross-team collaboration to resolve challenges.
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities based on customer needs.
* Experience coordinating and implementing digital solutions in a complex organizational environment.
* Hands-on experience with SaaS applications, including system configuration and integration.
* Experience working with cloud-based software and APIs.
* Working knowledge of security, access management, and data privacy for SaaS and AI solutions.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting to ensure reliable platform operations.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a role supporting digital products, preferably in an analyst or engineering role.

Who You'll Work With

* Directly interact with the Director & Chapter Lead and peers within the Product Portfolio.
* Collaborate with every member of your squad, including Product Owners, Scrum Leads, Software Engineers, and QA Engineers, as well as internal customers and technical members from other Product Portfolios.

Additional info

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Proactively monitoring and resolving issues, effectively communicating with key stakeholders and management.
* Leading with a strategic vision while managing technical challenges, ensuring detailed and effective execution.
* Identifying and solving non-routine problems independently, applying broad knowledge to troubleshoot system issues.
* Translating business needs into clear, actionable Agile user stories.
* Gaining a deep understanding of digital products to serve as a subject matter expert.
* Staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in the smart booking space to ensure our product portfolio aligns with market demands.
* Understanding IT architecture and effectively extracting and analyzing data across business systems.
* Organizing and presenting data to enable quick, informed decision-making.
* Prioritizing tasks and working independently, while communicating clearly across all levels of the organization.
* Managing multiple complex tasks with high-quality results within deadlines.
* Applying Agile methodologies and principles, including work estimation techniques.
* Quickly learning and adapting to new tools and technologies.
* Collaborating with multicultural, distributed teams across time zones and managing multiple projects concurrently.
* Stay current with trends in Smart Booking, SaaS, AI, automation, APIs, and data visualization.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Optum Technology Consumer Engineering organization is transforming how millions of people experience healthcare. As part of Optum's Chief Digital Office (CDO), we deliver digital first, personalized experiences that help consumers find, access, and navigate care, leveraging modern cloud platforms, data, AI, and conversational technologies at national scale.

Serving UnitedHealth Group's digital technology needs, the CDO organization supports experiences used by more than 30 million UnitedHealthcare members. Our mission is to radically improve how consumers and providers engage with the healthcare system by delivering intuitive, personalized, and trustworthy digital experiences across the healthcare journey.

Technical Product Managers within the CDO own the definition and delivery of complex, cross team digital and agentic experiences that are critical to Optum's consumer strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with business product managers, UX designers, engineers, architects, and fellow technical product managers to translate business priorities and user insights into well defined, outcome driven member experiences.

As a Technical Product Manager, you will translate strategy and lead execution across multiple teams and systems, operating with a high degree of autonomy. You will also lead AI accelerated product development and responsibly integrate AI into consumer experiences to improve speed, quality, and member outcomes.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Understand needs and define opportunities
  + Partner with business product and domain stakeholders to understand business objectives, user needs, and digital experience trends
  + Translate insights into clearly articulated, outcome driven opportunities that align with business priorities and consumer value
* Develop and support product roadmaps
  + Collaborate with business product counterparts to articulate strategy, prioritize opportunities, and define multi quarter roadmaps
  + Assess feasibility, dependencies, and costs to ensure roadmaps are executable and aligned with investment guardrails
* Define executable experiences and enhancements
  + Partner with UX, engineering, and architecture leaders to elaborate opportunities into clearly defined experiences, features, and enhancements
  + Ensure requirements and success metrics are unambiguous, testable, and aligned to intended member outcomes
* Technical fluency and solution partnership
  + Partner closely with engineering and architecture leaders to understand end to end system flows, technical constraints, and solution options
  + Evaluate technical alternatives, decompose complex problems into executable increments, and define requirements for dependent teams and systems
* Drive successful execution
  + Lead execution across multiple teams and platforms, sequencing work across dependencies and influencing backlog prioritization and trade off decisions
  + Proactively identify, manage, and resolve cross team risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate effectively when needed
  + Ensure delivery of high quality outcomes while managing costs within allocated budgets
* Champion AI accelerated product development and AI infused experiences
  + Champion the effective use of AI tools across product discovery, definition, delivery, and operations to improve speed and quality
  + Identify and elaborate opportunities to responsibly incorporate AI into member experiences, with clear measurement, monitoring, and feedback loops
* Operational excellence
  + Deeply understand how experiences perform in production, including usage, member sentiment, quality metrics, and operational issues
  + Use data and feedback to identify improvement opportunities and inform roadmap and prioritization decisions
* Executive ready communication
  + Communicate progress, trade offs, risks, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders
  + Articulate value through concise narratives, artifacts, and data backed insights tailored to both technical and non technical audiences
* Leadership and mentorship
  + Provide mentorship and informal leadership to other technical product managers
  + Raise the bar for product definition, execution rigor, and cross functional collaboration within the TPM community
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
* 7+ years of experience in technical or software product management, or closely related roles
* Demonstrated experience delivering complex, technology enabled digital products using modern product discovery and delivery practices
* Demonstrated solid ability to partner with and influence business, UX, engineering, architecture, and data teams
* Proven ability to operate effectively amid ambiguity, complexity, and cross portfolio dependencies
* Proven excellent written and verbal communication skills with both technical and non technical stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in the healthcare industry
* Experience delivering consumer facing web and mobile digital experiences at scale
* Experience integrating AI responsibly into customer facing digital products with measurable outcomes
* Experience using AI tools to improve product discovery, definition, delivery, and/or operational maturity
* Demonstrated solid presentation and storytelling skills, with experience influencing senior leaders

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes , an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie  
Intelligence Connected

**WoodMac.com**

**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**Job Description**

To support the development of our Lens data analytics platform, we are looking for a dynamic Senior Product Manager to be an integral part of our Commodities Product team covering Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals and Metals & Mining.

*Knowledge & experience*

* Experienced Product Manager, or Analyst looking to expand their role into the Product Management space
* Experience with the product development cycle including agile software development (Scrum/Kanban), design process, and instrumenting analytics.
* Basic industry knowledge and strong interest on one or multiple sectors covered in our portfolio (Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals, Metals & Mining), understanding of the major players, market conditions, and industry standards. Intellectual curiosity for industry is a must.
* Experience working on data migrations projects, and using AI in product development is a strong plus.
* Good oral and written communication skills
* Key tools that we use are JIRA, Productboard and Amplitude. Our tech stack is mainly on AWS and Snowflake.

*Impact on the team*

* Act as the day-to-day point person for the cross-functional team, providing a seamless bridge between Research Analysts, Data teams, UX, and Engineering to identify solutions that work within a set of defined constraints and align to the broader business strategy and achieve customer-focused results.
* Align understanding by defining user requirements with clear acceptance criteria across multiple features

* Engage frequently with users to gather feedback from relevant customers and internal stakeholders.

description:
**About Us:**

**Luna is a health intelligence company**. Our wearables and LifeOS platform build a working model of your body, and turn it into a plan for your day. Luna Ring and Luna Band read continuous biomarker signals, from sleep and recovery to heart rate variability, circadian phase and menstrual cycle. LifeOS combines that with your nutrition, supplements, blood panels and daily context to build a plan for your day: what to do, and when to do it. Luna ships to 150+ countries, and our work has been recognised by the global tech press and international design and innovation awards.

We're grounded in science, driven by data, and occasionally powered by questionable coffee choices. But above all, we’re united by a shared mission: to reimagine how wearable tech can help people know themselves better and push their potential further.

**Your Role:**

We’re looking for a Product Manager – App to lead our health-tech experience and build our LifeOS.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, CX, and our beta community to deliver features that are elegant, evidence-based, and habit-forming.

insights, and user journeys.

Sleep Recovery and AI-based health layer.

session engagement.

● Use data (Amplitude / Firebase / Mixpanel) to learn user behaviour

fluency.

● Exposure to AI productization, health APIs

● Demonstrated ability to improve app retention, adoption, or ratings through thoughtful product

changes.

● Deep familiarity with mobile UX, behavioral design, and habit loop creation.

● Comfort with using data tools (Amplitude, Firebase, etc.) and setting clear success metrics.

● High clarity of thought; can operate independently, structure ambiguity, and move

cross-functional teams.

● A strong POV on what makes a truly great app experience in the wellness space.

**What You’ll Get:**

● A front-row seat to the future of wearable intelligence

● Massive ownership and impact on a fast-growing global product

● Chance to build the world’s most advanced LifeOS.

● Competitive compensation + ESOPs

description:
Job Description: Vice President – Retail Banking

**Company:** HDFC Bank  
**Department:** Retail Banking / Business Banking  
**Job Title:** Vice President – Retail Banking  
**Experience:** 10–18 Years  
**Industry:** Banking and Financial Services

Job Summary

The Vice President – Retail Banking is responsible for leading retail banking business operations, driving revenue growth, expanding the customer base, and strengthening the bank's market position across assigned regions or business segments. The role involves developing business strategies, managing branch and relationship-management teams, increasing customer acquisition and retention, optimizing portfolio performance, and ensuring compliance with applicable banking regulations and internal policies.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and manage retail banking business operations across assigned regions, branches, or customer segments.
* Develop and execute strategies to achieve business growth, revenue, profitability, and portfolio targets.
* Drive customer acquisition, relationship expansion, customer retention, and long-term portfolio growth.
* Lead, mentor, and manage branch banking teams, relationship managers, and sales professionals.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with high-value customers, affluent clients, and other key customer segments.
* Drive cross-selling of retail banking products, including savings and current accounts, deposits, loans, credit cards, investments, and insurance, as applicable.
* Identify new business opportunities and develop market strategies to strengthen customer engagement and market share.
* Monitor business performance, portfolio quality, revenue generation, and operational efficiency.
* Oversee portfolio management and support effective identification, monitoring, and mitigation of business and credit risks.
* Ensure adherence to RBI regulations, applicable KYC and AML requirements, internal policies, and compliance standards.
* Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to implement strategic business initiatives.
* Prepare periodic business reviews, management reports, forecasts, and performance analyses.
* Establish performance objectives and monitor team productivity against business goals.
* Improve customer experience by strengthening service quality, relationship management, and operational processes.
* Promote a culture of accountability, ethical sales practices, risk awareness, and continuous improvement.

Candidate Requirements

* Graduate degree from a recognized university.
* MBA/PGDM in Finance, Banking, Business Administration, or Management preferred.
* 10–18 years of relevant experience in retail banking or financial services.
* Demonstrated experience in leading large teams and managing regional or multi-branch business operations.
* Proven track record of revenue generation, customer acquisition, portfolio growth, and target achievement.
* Strong understanding of retail banking products, customer segments, and distribution channels.
* Experience in business planning, financial performance monitoring, and portfolio management.
* Good understanding of banking regulations, risk management, KYC, AML, and compliance requirements.
* Excellent leadership, strategic thinking, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to build high-performing teams and drive business transformation.
* Experience with leading private-sector banks, NBFCs, or established financial institutions preferred.

Required Skills

* Retail Banking and Branch Banking
* Sales Leadership and Business Development
* Strategic Planning and Execution
* Revenue Growth and Profitability Management
* Customer Acquisition and Retention
* Relationship Management
* Portfolio Management
* Profit and Loss (P&L) Management
* Team Leadership and Performance Management
* Cross-Selling and Product Penetration
* Banking Products and Financial Services
* Risk Management and Regulatory Compliance
* Stakeholder Management
* Business Analytics and Performance Reporting
* Customer Experience and Service Excellence

Key Objective

To drive sustainable retail banking growth for HDFC Bank by leading high-performing teams, expanding customer relationships, increasing revenue and profitability, strengthening portfolio quality, and maintaining strong risk-management and regulatory-compliance standards.

Pay: ₹2,500,000.00 - ₹4,000,000.00 per year

title: Account Manager, SBS Engage, GCS
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in sales, business development, advertising, account management, marketing, or consulting.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA/Master’s Degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in sales, advertising, account management, or marketing.
* Experience leading and managing multiple projects with a broad range of internal/external stakeholders simultaneously.
* Knowledge of traditional and online marketing strategy, tactics, and products across all digital advertising product areas.
* Knowledge of the local market and ability to think strategically about complex issues and develop recommendations/action plans.

**About the job**
-----------------

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage a portfolio of customers to consistently deliver against goals, while prioritizing and delivering an excellent experience to customers.
* Establish credibility with executives and act as a trusted consultant to optimize/expand their advertising investment, understand business drivers, identify opportunities for growth, manage risks, and create multi-quarter plans for sustainable business growth.
* Drive business growth, long-term partnerships, business planning/strategy, reviews, and education for customers.
* Drive customer growth and contribute to overall team success.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to enable customer growth.

title: Brand Manager - Ostocalcium
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.

The Brand Manager – Ostocalcium role will deliver sustainable business growth by shaping brand strategy, identifying consumer and category opportunities, leading innovation and communication plans, and ensuring effective commercialization across channels and markets

* Strong stakeholder management and leadership skills.
* Proven experience in developing and executing brand strategies and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of consumer insights, market research, brand equity, and portfolio management.
* Experience managing cross\-functional stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Insights, and R\&D.

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

Strong strategic thinking, influencing skills, and ability to operate in a fast\-paced, matrix organization.  

*

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About dunnhumby**



dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.


**Product**



Our Product team owns the vision, strategy and roadmap for the dunnhumby platform — the data, science and software that powers retailers and brands around the world. We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.


**The Role**



The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.



You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.


**What You'll Be Doing**



You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.


* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)
* Identify opportunities to improve product performance through data analysis, experimentation and evidence\-based recommendations
* Work closely with Data Engineers and product squads to ensure the right data is captured, modelled and available for meaningful analysis
* Deliver end\-to\-end analytics, from defining requirements and success metrics through to presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders
* Build, maintain and continuously improve product performance dashboards that provide clear, actionable visibility into product health
* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences


**What We're Looking For**



You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision making through data
* Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
* Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification


**What You Can Expect From Us**



We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.



And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.


**India Benefits**


* Healthcare \& Family Cover: Group Medical Insurance of INR 500,000 for employees and dependents, plus dental and vision cover up to INR 5,000\.
* Protection: Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover with benefit levels linked to employee grade, including disability benefits.
* Retirement \& Wellbeing: Provident Fund, Gratuity, National Pension Scheme access, Indian Health Organisation membership, and confidential employee assistance support.
* Lifestyle \& Flexibility: Office commute support, internet allowance of INR 2,000 per month for blended working, work\-from\-home kit support, subsidised food, and wellbeing resources.
* Recognition \& Extras: Long service awards, Talent Scout referral programme, and family milestone support.
* Time Off \& Family Leave: 25 days holiday plus 10 public holidays, paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off for your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**



At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.



We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.



For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found(here)
